hero.headline: Good websites don’t happen by
hero.intro: I’m Narada, a Web Publisher at Acuity Analytics. I have a BSc in Chemistry from the University of Sri Jayewardenepura and I’m studying for a BIT at the University of Moratuwa. I check every page, link and detail, and I’m growing from content into code.

about.title: I notice the raindrop on the petal.
about.text: Someone checks every page, every link and every detail. That’s my job. I kept CSR Australia’s Gyprock, Bradford and Hebel sites consistent in Sitecore at BISTEC Global, and now publish and QA websites for global clients at Acuity Analytics, covering SEO, accessibility and brand.

faq.a: Narada is a Web Publisher at Acuity Analytics in Colombo, Sri Lanka. He publishes and quality-checks websites for global clients, covering CMS work, SEO, accessibility and brand consistency, and builds software in C# and Python.
He has a BSc in Chemistry from the University of Sri Jayewardenepura, taught Chemistry for over two years, and is now studying for a Bachelor of Information Technology at the University of Moratuwa.

faq.q: Which tools and technologies does he use?
faq.a: Sitecore, WordPress, Beaver Builder, Siteimprove, Smartling and Adobe Workfront for web publishing; C#/.NET, Python, MariaDB and JavaScript for development.
Email naradadenasa@gmail.com, or send a message on LinkedIn. His CV is available as a PDF on this site, and his code is on GitHub at github.com/NaradaJ.
